usage.callShape: GET https://twitter.surf.cascade.fyi/users/{username} (no body; username is a path segment, e.g. hwchase17). Also accepts numeric user IDs.
usage.outputShape: body.data — the user profile object: body.data.id, body.data.username, body.data.name, body.data.description, body.data.profile_image_url, body.data.verified, body.data.created_at, body.data.public_metrics.{followers_count,following_count,tweet_count,like_count,media_count}, body.data.pinned_tweet_ids[]
usage.guide: Look up a Twitter/X user profile by passing the username (or numeric ID) as the final path segment of a plain GET request: GET https://twitter.surf.cascade.fyi/users/hwchase17. No request body or API key is needed — pay the x402 quote (~$0.001 USDC, settles on Base or Solana). The profile is returned synchronously under body.data, including name, description, verified flag, profile image URL, and public_metrics (follower/following/tweet counts). The wider service also exposes tweet-by-id, user timelines, following lists, and replies via sibling routes.
